summary.zh: 寺庙与公园池塘里的锦鲤是观赏型鲤鱼，经日本人工选育。
summary.en: Koi in temple and park ponds are ornamental carp selected in Japan.

field_marks.zh: 口角有两对须，背鳍长且前部有锯齿状硬刺。锦鲤颜色多样，由选育得到。
field_marks.en: Two pairs of barbels at the mouth; a long dorsal fin with a serrated spine. Koi colours are the result of selection.

story.zh: 鲤的基因组显示额外发生过一次全基因组复制，约在数百万年前，使其基因组呈四倍体特征。锦鲤的分类地位有争议，有观点将其归于 C. rubrofuscus。
story.en: The carp genome records an additional whole-genome duplication several million years ago, giving a tetraploid-like genome. The taxonomic status of koi is debated, with some authors using C. rubrofuscus.

notes.zh: 全年可见，水温适宜的 4–10 月最活跃。请勿投喂寺庙规定之外的食物。
notes.en: Visible all year, most active April–October. Feed only what the site permits.
